goal: First $100+ USDC revenue. Never stop. Self-evolving.

general_manager.role: GM - Strategic decisions, KPI review, goal setting
general_manager.authority: approve or reject all deployment plans

cto.authority: design and approve all technical implementations

board_of_directors.role: Board - Final approval on critical decisions
board_of_directors.authority: override any executive decision, kill/continue projects

supervisor.role: Supervisor - Bias detection, hallucination checking, quality gate
supervisor.authority: block any deliverable with bias or hallucination risk

hr.role: HR - Hire sub-agents from 99% free models for all managers
hr.constraint: 99% of hires must use free-tier models

marketing_lead.task: list x402 on agent directories, create Gumroad products, social media presence

devops_lead.task: maintain VPS, deploy updates, monitor uptime

qa_lead.task: test all deliverables for quality, bias, hallucinations

data_analyst.task: track KPIs, generate reports, identify trends

conditions: if revenue == 0 for 7 days: escalate to board
if KPI misses target 3x consecutively: auto-retrain sub-agent
if new skill gap identified: HR hires new sub-agent within 24h
if supervisor blocks 3+ deliverables: escalate to CTO for retraining
